description: The chart titled “Average performance on November 2024 AMC 10/12 tests” illustrates average test scores for a set of language models, shown as a single series of vertical bars with error bars. The horizontal axis contains the model categories, displayed as angled labels in left-to-right order: “70B,” “Claude 3.5 Sonnet,” “Qwen 2.5 14b-instruct,” “GPT 4o,” “GPT 4o-mini,” “Qwen 2.5 72b-instruct,” “Gemini Flash 1.5,” “Gemini Pro 1.5,” and “phi-4.” The vertical axis is labeled “Average score (temperature = 0.5)” and uses a linear numeric scale spanning roughly from 60 to 95, with visible tick marks at 60, 70, 80, and 90. A legend in the upper-left indicates two color encodings: light blue for “Large model” and dark blue for “Small model.” The bars and their annotated values are approximately: 70B (light blue) 66.4; Claude 3.5 Sonnet (light blue) 74.8; Qwen 2.5 14b-instruct (dark blue) 77.4; GPT 4o (light blue) 77.9; GPT 4o-mini (dark blue) 78.2; Qwen 2.5 72b-instruct (light blue) 78.7; Gemini Flash 1.5 (dark blue) 81.6; Gemini Pro 1.5 (light blue) 89.8; and phi-4 (dark blue) 91.8. Each bar has a small black error bar with caps, and the bars are not presented as grouped clusters beyond the alternating color indicating model size; the categories appear arranged in an increasing pattern by the displayed score values, and no individual bar is specially highlighted beyond the value labels above each bar.
